recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Follow up in HL7/fhir-extensions by making StructureDefinition/list-category repeatable, or by documenting why the requested 0..* cardinality is represented elsewhere. Treat any List category search parameter as separate work unless there is an explicit work-group decision, because it appeared in comments but not in the voted resolution.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core List issue. It asked for List.code to become 0..* for XDS Folder use cases; the final resolution instead required a core List category extension, 0..*, with CodeableConcept values for categories or classes that a List belongs to.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-19822 was found. Pickaxe history found 0d13d336c54416a0d3d5fcad86b769788fbc1898, which added StructureDefinition/list-category to the core List implementation guide as a CodeableConcept extension on List. That definition used Extension.max = 1. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed core extension definitions, including list-category, from the R5 source.
additional_context: List remains an active core resource and current source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml keeps List.code at 0..1, which matches the voted resolution and the #ihe discussion where List.code remained the visible SubmissionSet/Folder discriminator. The list-category definition is now in the FHIR Extension Pack, and later FHIR-44349 maintenance was applied in HL7/fhir-extensions. The current Extension Pack definition has context List and value CodeableConcept, but Extension.max = 1 while repeatable extensions in that repository use Extension.max = *.
reconciliation: No HL7/fhir source file was changed. Re-adding list-category to the core source would undo the later extension-pack split, and changing List.code to 0..* would contradict the resolution. The remaining apparent cardinality gap belongs in HL7/fhir-extensions.
